{{Top|leg}}
'''Synthecrete''' was a cheap building material. It was commonly used to create flat Hangar/Legends|landing fields, which served as [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] on [[Technology level|low-technology]] worlds.<ref name="GG6">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref>
